description: The student read page article list was empty for signed-in students. getSearchArticles joined userActivity.targetId (text) to articles.id (uuid) without a cast, so Postgres rejected the query (42883). Defect introduced by the Prisma-to-Drizzle migration in edf87e4cf. Found by owner manual verification S5.1 on 2026-09-23.
deviation_notes: One-line cast fix. Live-verified in the browser during owner manual verification session S5.
